name: STIGMATA MAYDIS
urinary_symptoms: Suppression and retention. Dysuria. Renal lithiasis; nephritic colic; blood and red sand in urine. Tenesmus after urinating. Vesical catarrh. Gonorrhśa. Cystitis.
